title: Retention of serious-event reporting records
rule_summary: A pharmacy must retain readily retrievable records relating to reportable improper dispensing and serious adverse drug events for at least five years from filing the report.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply record retention requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.
exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing record retention with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
